  },
  "threats": [
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "All analysts can access customer PII regardless of role needs",
      "scenario": "Any analyst with warehouse access can query and view customer emails, phone numbers, and purchase history even if their analytics work doesn't require identifying individuals. This over-privileged access increases the risk of unauthorized use, accidental exposure, or insider threats, and expands the blast radius if any analyst account is compromised.",
      "component": "Analytics warehouse access control",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "All analysts have read access to the warehouse" },
        { "quote": "including email addresses, phone numbers and purchase history" }

      "cwe": ["CWE-269"],
      "plainLanguage": "Any analyst can see customer emails and phone numbers even if they don't need them for their work",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Restrict warehouse access to minimum required data per role",
        "given": "analysts need customer data for analytics",
        "when": "accessing the analytics warehouse",
        "then": "access should be limited to only the data fields and rows each analyst role requires, with approval for PII access"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Repudiation",
      "title": "No audit logging of analyst access to customer PII",
      "scenario": "A malicious or curious analyst queries customer data inappropriately—perhaps looking up friends, competitors, or celebrities—but there's no audit trail to detect, investigate, or prove the access occurred. This prevents compliance with data protection regulations and makes incident response impossible.",
      "component": "Analytics warehouse audit system",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "All analysts have read access to the warehouse" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V7.1.1", "V7.1.2"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-778"],
      "plainLanguage": "There's no record of which analysts look at customer data, so we can't catch misuse or prove compliance",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Log all accesses to customer PII in the warehouse",
        "given": "analysts can query customer PII",
        "when": "any user queries, views, or exports customer data from the warehouse",
        "then": "the access must be logged with user identity, timestamp, query, and data accessed, retained for at least 90 days"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Customer data transmitted without encryption",
      "scenario": "An attacker with access to the internal network (via compromised employee device, WiFi, or physical network tap) intercepts the nightly export traffic and captures customer emails, phone numbers, and purchase history in cleartext as the data moves from the source database to the warehouse.",
      "component": "Export job network connection",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "A nightly job copies the customers table" },
        { "quote": "including email addresses, phone numbers and purchase history" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V9.1.1", "V9.1.2"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-319"],
      "plainLanguage": "Customer data might be sent over the network without encryption, letting attackers on the internal network capture it",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Encrypt data in transit between source and warehouse",
        "given": "customer PII is transferred to the analytics warehouse",
        "when": "the nightly export job runs",
        "then": "the connection must use TLS 1.2 or higher with certificate validation, or use a secure tunnel"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Customer PII stored unencrypted in analytics warehouse",
      "scenario": "An attacker gains filesystem access, backup media access, or database file access to the warehouse through a separate vulnerability or physical breach. They can read customer emails, phone numbers, and purchase history directly from the database files or backups in plaintext.",
      "component": "Analytics warehouse storage",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "into the analytics warehouse" },
        { "quote": "including email addresses, phone numbers and purchase history" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V6.2.1", "V8.3.6"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-312"],
      "plainLanguage": "Customer data stored in the warehouse might not be encrypted, so anyone who gets storage or backup access can read it",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Encrypt customer PII at rest in the warehouse",
        "given": "customer PII is stored in the analytics warehouse",
        "when": "data is at rest in the warehouse database or backups",
        "then": "it must be encrypted using AES-256 or equivalent with keys managed separately from the data"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "Full customer table exported when analytics may not require all PII",
      "scenario": "Analysts perform aggregate analytics (trends, segments, behavior patterns) that don't require identifying specific individuals, but they receive raw email addresses and phone numbers anyway. This increases the blast radius if the warehouse is breached or an analyst account is compromised, as more PII is exposed than necessary.",
      "component": "Export job data selection",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "copies the customers table, including email addresses, phone numbers and purchase history" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.3.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-213"],
      "plainLanguage": "Analysts get full customer contact details even though most analytics work doesn't need to identify specific people",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Export only the minimum PII required for analytics",
        "given": "analysts perform analytics on customer data",
        "when": "the nightly export runs",
        "then": "PII fields should be masked, pseudonymized, or excluded unless specific approved analyses require them"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Spoofing",
      "title": "Export job runs without authenticated identity",
      "scenario": "An attacker who has compromised the job scheduler, gained access to the scheduling system, or positioned themselves on the network impersonates the legitimate export job. They run a malicious version that exfiltrates customer data to an external system or injects poisoned data into the warehouse.",
      "component": "Nightly export job authentication",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "A nightly job copies the customers table" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V2.7.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-306"],
      "plainLanguage": "The export job might not prove its identity to the database, letting an attacker run a fake export to steal data",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Authenticate the export job to source and warehouse systems",
        "given": "the job accesses customer PII",
        "when": "the nightly export connects to the source database and warehouse",
        "then": "it must authenticate using a dedicated service account with credentials rotated at least quarterly"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "No data retention policy causes indefinite accumulation of old PII",
      "scenario": "Customer data accumulates in the warehouse indefinitely. Years-old records for customers who deleted their accounts or requested data deletion remain accessible to analysts, violating data minimization principles and potentially privacy regulations like GDPR's right to be forgotten.",
      "component": "Analytics warehouse data lifecycle",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "A nightly job copies the customers table" },
        { "quote": "into the analytics warehouse" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.3.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-404"],
      "plainLanguage": "Old customer data might never be deleted from the warehouse, keeping unnecessary PII around and violating privacy rules",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Implement data retention and purging for the warehouse",
        "given": "customer PII is copied nightly to the warehouse",
        "when": "data exceeds the retention period needed for analytics or when customers request deletion",
        "then": "it must be automatically purged from the warehouse"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Tampering",
      "title": "No integrity verification of exported customer data",
      "scenario": "A bug in the export job code, a network issue, or an attacker modifying data in transit causes customer records to be corrupted or altered during the copy. Analysts make business decisions based on incorrect data, and the corruption goes undetected because there's no validation that the warehouse data matches the source.",
      "component": "Export job data validation",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "A nightly job copies the customers table" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V5.5.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-345"],
      "plainLanguage": "There's no check that customer data arrived intact from the source, so corruption or tampering might go unnoticed",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Verify integrity of exported data",
        "given": "customer data is copied from source to warehouse",
        "when": "the nightly export completes",
        "then": "the job must verify row counts and checksums match the source and alert on mismatches"
      }
    }
  ]
}
